exactTitle: Marking Fraction Lengths on the Number Line

proposedCompetencyMapping.text: Explores and understands sets of numbers — whole numbers, fractions, integers, rational numbers, real numbers — and their properties, and visualises them on the number line
proposedCompetencyMapping.justification: Direct: the competency names the number line explicitly, and this section is its Grade 6 realisation for fractions. Among the least interpretive mappings available.

proposedCompetencyMapping.text: Explores and applies fractions (both as ratios and in decimal form) in daily-life situations
proposedCompetencyMapping.justification: Supporting: the section treats a fraction as a LENGTH, which is the measurement sense underpinning ratio use. Weaker than C-1.4 and offered for educator confirmation, not asserted.

decisionsUnderReview.B1: Fractions covers 5 of 9 official sections; §7.4 is uncovered.
decisionsUnderReview.C1: MIDDLE:C-1.4 is the primary competency for §7.4.
decisionsUnderReview.C2: MIDDLE:C-1.6 is a supporting competency for §7.4.
